description:
Participant facet history

A daily time series over one participant facet dimension (adoption curves / QoQ trends), from daily snapshots of the rollup. History accrues from the day the feature shipped. Keyless-cacheable.

dimension.description: Which series to return: `total` (whole-network count) or a facet dimension.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD UTC). Defaults to 90 days ago.

key.description: Comma-separated facet keys to filter to (e.g. `BE,NL` for `dimension=country`). Omit for every key in the dimension.

limit.description: Max points returned, clamped to [1, 10000]. Defaults to 10000.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD UTC). Defaults to today.

name: get_participant_stats_history
